items.name: sentry-base
items.title: Sentry Base Theme
items.description: Complete Sentry design system theme for shadcn — purple-tinted neutrals, Blurple primary, Rubik typography, both light and dark modes. Includes warning, success, and promotion semantic tokens beyond the shadcn defaults.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Sentry chonk button with embossed depth on solid variants.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Surfaced tooltip overlay built on Base UI.

items.name: interaction-state-layer
items.title: Interaction State Layer
items.description: Regular Scraps interaction overlay for hover, press, selected, and expanded states.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Sentry alert with the colored icon rail, system banner, expand/collapse, trailing items, and AlertLink.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Contextual highlighted text element with semantic and feature variants.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Status pill with optional leading icon and dismiss button.

items.name: feature-badge
items.title: Feature Badge
items.description: Square tooltip badge for annotating feature rollout stages (alpha, beta, new, experimental, debug).

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Single-select radio group with sm/md sizes (accent fill + white dot).
